21. (Original) A regional oximetry system comprising:
a display;
a sensor port adapted to communicate with at least one sensor; and
at least one processor, the processor causing a plurality of views to be displayed on the display, each view configured to occupy at least a portion of the display;
wherein a set sensor menu view is configured to occupy at least a portion of the display and adapted to present a connectivity status of the sensor port and the at least one sensor.
22. (Currently Amended) The regional oximetry system according to claim 212 further comprising:
a pod array adapted to communicate with the at least one sensor and with the sensor port;
wherein the set sensor menu view presents a connectivity status of the pod array with the connectivity status of the sensor port and the at least one sensor.
23. (Currently Amended) The regional oximetry system according to claim 222 wherein the pod array is adapted to communicate with a plurality of sensors.
24. (Currently Amended) The regional oximetry system according to claim 222 wherein the set sensor menu view displays a graphical representation of the connectivity status of the sensor port, the pod array, and the at least one sensor.
25. (Currently Amended) The regional oximetry system of claim [[20]] 21, wherein the set sensor menu view presents a human form to display potential sites of a patient's body where a sensor can be placed.
26. (New) The regional oximetry system of Claim 25, wherein the human form comprises one of an adult human form and corresponding potential sites where a sensor can be placed and a child human form and corresponding potential sites where a sensor can be placed.
27. (New) The regional oximetry system of Claim 25, wherein the display is configured to receive a selection or one or more of the potential sites where sensors have been placed.
28. (New) The regional oximetry system of Claim 21, further comprising:
a first sensor port configured to receive at least a first physiological signal;
a second sensor port configured to receive at least a second physiological signal;
and a differential analysis view is configured to occupy at least a portion of the display, the differential analysis view configured to represent a differential analysis between a first parameter derived from the first physiological signal and a second parameter derived from the second physiological signal.
29. (New) The regional oximetry system of Claim 28, wherein:
the first parameter comprises a regional tissue oxygenation level; and
the second parameter comprises arterial oxygen saturation level.
30. (New) The regional oximetry system of Claim 29, wherein the differential analysis view comprises a first view that presents a first trend graph of the first physiological signal and a second trend graph of the second physiological signal, and wherein the first trend graph and the second trend graph are aligned such that an area between the first trend graph and the second trend graph is representative of a differential analysis of regional-to-central oxygen saturation/
31. (New) The regional oximetry system of Claim 30, wherein the differential analysis view further comprises a numerical representation of a currently-measured differential analysis of regional-to-central oxygen saturation, and wherein a second view presents the numerical representation of the currently-measured differential analysis of regional-to-central oxygen saturation.
32. (New) The regional oximetry system of Claim 31, wherein the differential analysis view presents both the first view and the second view at the same time.
